item.title: And AI Came to the Classroom
item.author: marc.alier@upc.edu (Marc Alier)
item.description: Legend has it that the wise Anand (a name suggested by ChatGPT, whom I call Skippy ^2) helped King Devendra (a name also proposed by Skippy) solve a difficult problem. In gratitude Devendra offered Anand the payment he desired. Anand asked that the king give him a grain of rice for the first square of a chessboard and that he double the amount in each successive square. The king accepted, but after a good while the king’s mathematicians informed him that there was not enough wheat in the entire kingdom to pay what Anand asked for.

item.title: Participation in a session on AI and teaching at UIC
item.author: marc.alier@upc.edu (Marc Alier)
item.description: On March 2, 2023, I took part in the session on AI chatbots in higher education organized by the Universitat Internacional de Catalunya UIC. At https://www.linkedin.com/events/sessi-sobrexatbotsd-intel-lig-n7034187811851235329/comments/ you can find the video of the event. Yours truly and his talk appear starting at 1h:25 minutes.

item.title: Videos from the course ChatGPT: Opportunity and Challenge for Teaching v.1
item.author: marc.alier@upc.edu (Marc Alier)
item.description: If you’re an educator and you’re interested in generative AI and its applications in teaching, you’ll be glad to know you can now access the videos from the course “ChatGPT: Opportunity and Challenge for Teaching” on my YouTube channel. This course covers ChatGPT, a text-generating AI tool introduced at the end of 2022, and its implications for university teaching.
